senses.zh_definition: 词形 logan 尚未核实。输入所附的“用于记录事项详情的簿册，尤指车辆维护等记录簿”是 log 的释义，不能直接移作 logan 的正式释义。
senses.en_definition: Unverified headword. The supplied definition belongs to log: a book used to record details of activities, maintenance, or other matters.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk logan belum disahkan berdasarkan sumber yang diperiksa. Takrif dalam paket merujuk kepada log, iaitu buku untuk mencatat butiran sesuatu perkara, seperti penyenggaraan kenderaan.
senses.nuances: noun 词性暂随所附 log 释义保留，并非对 logan 的独立认证。以下搭配均属于 log；例句仅以引述方式讨论 logan。不能据此断言所有领域均不存在 logan，但现有证据不足以标为 official。参见 [DBP：log](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=log)。

etymology.historical_story: The packet contains a revealing editorial mismatch: its requested headword is logan, while its dictionary extract explicitly identifies log. This illustrates why a plausible-looking ending cannot establish a word’s history or meaning. The record-book definition can support an entry for log, but no independent etymology for logan can responsibly be reconstructed from the supplied material.
